name: @arraypress/waveform-bar
description: Persistent bottom audio player bar for WaveformPlayer - queue management, page persistence, and seamless playback.

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: npm run build:iife && npm run build:esm && npm run build:min
scripts.build:css: cp src/css/waveform-bar.css dist/ && esbuild src/css/waveform-bar.css --minify --outfile=dist/waveform-bar.min.css && cp src/css/waveform-bar-icons.css dist/ && rm -rf dist/icons && cp -r src/icons dist/icons
scripts.size: npm run build && echo 'JS:' && gzip -c dist/waveform-bar.min.js | wc -c && echo 'CSS:' && gzip -c dist/waveform-bar.min.css | wc -c

author: ArrayPress
